# Wise
> Wise helps people and businesses send, spend, receive, and manage money internationally across 160+ countries and 40+ currencies.

Wise offers personal and business multi-currency accounts, international transfers, debit cards, pricing tools, and platform infrastructure for embedded cross-border payments.

## Personal
- [Personal account](https://wise.com/ca/account/): Multi-currency account for holding, converting, and managing money across many currencies.
- [Send money](https://wise.com/ca/send-money/): International money transfers with transparent fees and exchange rates.
- [Send large amounts](https://wise.com/ca/large-amounts/): Support and guidance for higher-value international transfers.
- [Receive money](https://wise.com/ca/receive-money/): Get paid from abroad using local account details and international transfers.
- [Get a debit card](https://wise.com/ca/card/): Spend internationally with a debit card linked to your Wise balances.
- [Personal pricing](https://wise.com/ca/pricing/): Fees for personal transfers, account features, and card-related services.

## Business
- [Wise Business](https://wise.com/ca/business/): Business account for international payments, balances, and team spending.
- [Pay invoices](https://wise.com/ca/business/invoices): Send business payments to suppliers and invoices across borders.
- [Receive money for business](https://wise.com/ca/business/receive-money): Accept international payments with business account details in supported currencies.
- [Business card](https://wise.com/ca/business/card): Debit card for business spending, subscriptions, and employee expenses.
- [Manage team finances](https://wise.com/ca/business/manage-team): Controls for team access, approvals, and shared financial operations.
- [Connect accounting software](https://wise.com/ca/business/accounting-software): Integrations for syncing transactions with accounting and finance tools.
- [Business pricing](https://wise.com/ca/pricing/business): Fees for business transfers, account services, and card usage.

## Platform and API
- [Wise Platform](https://wise.com/platform/): Embedded finance infrastructure for integrating international payments into products.
- [Business API](https://wise.com/ca/business/api): API integrations for automating transfers, payouts, and financial workflows.
- [Platform demo](https://wise.com/business-demo): Interactive demo for Wise business and platform capabilities.
- [Contact sales](https://wise.com/gb/business/contact?click_cta_id=gb_bhomepage_top): Sales contact page for business and platform enquiries.

## Pricing and Fees
- [Personal pricing](https://wise.com/ca/pricing/): Overview of personal fees for transfers, cards, and account services.
- [Business pricing](https://wise.com/ca/pricing/business): Overview of business fees for payments, balances, and cards.
- [Send money](https://wise.com/ca/send-money/): Transfer flow for checking routes, fees, and delivery estimates.
- [Large amount transfers](https://wise.com/ca/large-amounts/): Information relevant to pricing and support for larger transfers.

## Receiving Money
- [Receive money](https://wise.com/ca/receive-money/): Personal options for getting paid internationally into Wise.
- [Business receive money](https://wise.com/ca/business/receive-money): Business tools for collecting overseas payments in supported currencies.
- [Personal account](https://wise.com/ca/account/): Account features for holding balances and receiving funds.
- [Wise Business](https://wise.com/ca/business/): Business account capabilities for incoming international payments.

## Cards and Spending
- [Personal debit card](https://wise.com/ca/card/): Card for spending abroad and online from multi-currency balances.
- [Business card](https://wise.com/ca/business/card): Business spending card for teams, travel, and recurring expenses.
- [Personal account](https://wise.com/ca/account/): Manage balances used for card spending and currency conversion.
- [Manage team finances](https://wise.com/ca/business/manage-team): Set permissions and oversight for business card usage.

## Accounting and Operations
- [Connect accounting software](https://wise.com/ca/business/accounting-software): Sync Wise activity with accounting platforms and bookkeeping workflows.
- [Manage team finances](https://wise.com/ca/business/manage-team): Operational controls for finance teams and delegated access.
- [Pay invoices](https://wise.com/ca/business/invoices): Streamline supplier and invoice payments across countries.
- [Business API](https://wise.com/ca/business/api): Automate treasury, payouts, and payment operations programmatically.

## International Transfers
- [Send money](https://wise.com/ca/send-money/): Core international transfer service for personal customers.
- [Send large amounts](https://wise.com/ca/large-amounts/): Transfer larger sums with additional support and information.
- [Pay invoices](https://wise.com/ca/business/invoices): Business cross-border payments for vendors and invoices.
- [Wise Platform](https://wise.com/platform/): Infrastructure for integrating cross-border transfers into other products.

## Entry Points
- [Wise Canada homepage](https://wise.com/): Main entry point for Wise personal and business products.
- [Personal](https://wise.com/ca/account/): Starting point for individual multi-currency account features.
- [Business](https://wise.com/ca/business/): Starting point for business payments and account features.
- [Platform](https://wise.com/platform/): Starting point for embedded payments and infrastructure offerings.
